parent_objective: materialize no-training metadata preflight for controller-family decisive task-source mapping
blocked_by: need metadata-level source mapping before any task-source rollout or controller-family benchmark
supersedes: direct decisive task rollout after M1676

public_gates: M1677 must write summary and task_source_mapping artifacts
M1677 must not run training replay PPO or environment rollout
M1677 must classify M1615 use as diagnostic-only or safely mappable
M1677 must report source-family task-family edge window and source-share counts
M1677 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact
do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: writes no-training task-source mapping metadata before any decisive rollout

stop_condition: stop if mapping artifacts are missing
stop if private holdout is used
stop if M1615 hidden tensors/actions become benchmark targets
stop if source-diversity counts are not reported
fallback_plan: route to fresh source-generation design if metadata mapping fails
route to mapping audit if metadata preflight passes
route to standard-layer negative story only if decisive mapping is impossible

admission_evidence: M1675 shows standard layer is non-decisive
allowed_updates: M1677 status queue scoreboard research log and review

history_necessity_tests: preflight must report whether T4/T5 task sources can support L2 current-tiled and L3 reset controls
preflight must not claim history necessity from metadata

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If metadata cannot support controller-family-compatible decisive tasks, record scenario-sampling limitation and route to fresh source generation.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Existing public decisive-history metadata can be mapped into a controller-family-compatible task-source preflight without leaking L3-specific proof tensors.
success_criteria: candidate source-family task-family edge window and source-share counts are reported
training replay PPO environment rollout promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked

private holdout promotion actor-input changes or environment rollout occur
metadata preflight claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
